title: Boeing Reports Certification Progress on 737 MAX and 777-9
summary: Boeing says the path to certification for the 737 MAX 7, MAX 10, and the long-delayed 777-9 widebody has become clear, with key flight-test and regulatory milestones now in sight after years of delay.

title: Electric Air Taxis Push Toward FAA Certification
summary: Joby, Archer, Beta, and Wisk are all advancing through the FAA's staged type-certification process for eVTOL aircraft, with type inspection authorization testing expected to intensify through 2026.

title: Boom Supersonic's XB-1 Breaks the Sound Barrier
summary: Boom Supersonic's XB-1 demonstrator became the first independently developed civil aircraft to fly supersonic, reaching Mach 1.122 over the Mojave Desert as it validates technology for the planned Overture airliner.

title: NASA's X-59 Flies Supersonic for the First Time
summary: NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic research aircraft exceeded the speed of sound for the first time, a key step toward proving an aircraft can go supersonic without a disruptive sonic boom reaching the ground.

title: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Production Set to Reach 2.4 Million Tonnes
summary: Global sustainable aviation fuel production is projected to reach about 2.4 million tonnes in 2026, still under 1% of total jet fuel use, as the industry works to scale supply toward its 2050 net-zero targets.
